name: Greyfront
summary:
Greyfront is an intense, action-packed game available on the App Store, where you take on the role of a soldier who is determined to keep his identity a secret, ready to face death in any condition. Driven by the desire to test his own skills and endurance, this soldier takes on enemies without relying on weapons or health pickups. The game challenges you to play like life itself—raw, unforgiving, and realistic.

In Greyfront, survival is the ultimate goal. The soldier must defeat numerous enemies and navigate through tough, relentless situations, relying only on his wit, agility, and fighting instincts. Every battle is a test of courage, skill, and strategy, as there are no easy ways to regain strength or stockpile ammunition. It's all about staying sharp and outsmarting your opponents to survive.

Do you have what it takes to survive in Greyfront and prove you're the ultimate warrior?
